title: normpdf
summary: Evaluate the normal probability density function.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host for compatibility until a provider hook exists.

description: `normpdf(x)` evaluates the standard normal density. `normpdf(x,mu)` and `normpdf(x,mu,sigma)` evaluate a normal distribution with mean `mu` and standard deviation `sigma`.
behaviors: `x`, `mu`, and `sigma` may be scalars or matching-size numeric arrays.

faqs.question: What is the default distribution?
faqs.answer: The default is the standard normal distribution with `mu = 0` and `sigma = 1`.
